The '''''Exsanguinator''''' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
Its destruction marked the first success of the legendary [[Cracken Flight Group]].<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>
